segments.text: Free local links boost your ranking by 14 percent.
segments.narration: Free local links boost your ranking by 14 percent. Want more local customers finding your business online?
Pages without any backlinks get no organic search traffic 91 percent of the time, so even a handful of free local links puts you ahead.

According to Whitespark's 2026 Local Search Ranking Factors, businesses with local backlinks from regional sites, newspapers, and industry associations rank 14 percent higher in the Local Pack than those without.
GBP signals account for 32 percent of Local Pack ranking weight, so this is the most important local property you control.
Given that buying a single backlink averages $361.44 (BuzzStream, 2025), free editorial links from local press are worth real money.
Since 93.8 percent of link builders now prioritize link quality over quantity (SEO.AI, 2025), one HARO win can outweigh dozens of low-grade directory links.
With 46 percent of all Google searches carrying local intent (Marketing LTB, 2025), every locally-relevant link compounds.
